newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 20.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones shed 18.88 points to 6,877.68.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index of 100 large-capitalisation stocks rose 7.96 points to 1,234.83.
* The all-share EMAS index gained 1.22 points to 361.75.
* Renong group financial results expected after 0900 GMT.
* Financial services group Hong Leong Credit posted a 34 percent increase in net profit for the six months to December 31, 1996.
* Marine engineering and reclamation company Hock Seng Lee proposed to develop an industrial township in eastern Sarawak state costing three billion ringgit .
